from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures the essential information from a single legal document for cause-of-action sorting."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the legal document found in the text")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific cause of action/category extracted from the document that matches the provided list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the extracted information from all processed documents."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
